description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Finds meeting slots inside every participant's working hours (each in their own IANA time zone, daylight-saving changes included) that avoid all their busy times (optionally with a buffer). Returns each slot in your display zone and in every participant's local time, so nobody has to convert. Up to 31 days, 20 participants. Deterministic: zone rules come from the IANA database, not a guessed offset.

bufferMinutes.description: keep this much free before and after busy times

displayTimeZone.description: zone for from/to and for listing slots; default the first participant's

from.description: first date to search, YYYY-MM-DD, in the display zone

busy.description: busy times as instants with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T15:00:00Z or 2026-11-02T08:00:00-07:00

workingHours.description: default 09:00-17:00, Monday to Friday, in their own zone

stepMinutes.description: start times on this grid of the display zone's clock, default 30

name: find_free_slots
title: Meeting times that work for everyone (time zones and DST handled)
